visual_prompt: Recreate the attached reference ad exactly: same composition, framing, typography, text positions, color palette, background and photo style. The only change is the headline wording. Square 1:1 beauty-supplement ad on a flat warm cream background (#FBF3DC) with a very subtle soft vignette. TOP: a centered two-line headline in extra-bold geometric sans-serif uppercase, solid near-black, tight leading, spanning about 75% of the width. MIDDLE: a 2x2 grid of four equal landscape panels with softly rounded corners and a hairline pale-gold border, separated by a narrow cream gutter and filling the width inside even margins. Every panel shows the same scene: a bright airy cream-white bedroom with tall sheer white curtains glowing with soft daylight, a bed with white and beige linen at the left edge, and a green potted palm in a white pot at the right. In each panel the same young Latina woman with dark brown hair in a high ponytail, wearing a white racerback sports top and terracotta-brown high-waisted leggings, stands slightly right of the panel center in a three-quarter back view, looking over her left shoulder toward the camera with a soft confident smile, framed from head to upper thigh at eye level. Identical woman, outfit, pose, room and light in all four panels; exactly as in the reference, from the first to the fourth panel her hip and glute silhouette looks gradually and gently fuller. In the upper-left corner inside each panel there is a small bold uppercase metallic-gold day label: top-left panel, top-right panel, bottom-left panel, bottom-right panel in timeline order. BOTTOM LEFT: the product group standing on the cream canvas with soft contact shadows: a tall rectangular lemon-yellow carton with the lowercase black wordmark at the top and the product name in white uppercase letters running vertically on its front face; in front of it at its right, the user's product, a 60 ml amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders, a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper, with a wraparound label that fades from bright lemon yellow at the top to white at the bottom, carrying the lowercase black wordmark, the large white uppercase product name, a small dark descriptor line and five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle and its label; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Behind and to the right of the bottle, a delicate thin pale-gold botanical sprig line drawing. BOTTOM RIGHT: a wide horizontal brushed metallic gold plaque with rounded corners, a thin lighter inner border and a subtle bevel sheen, vertically centered in the bottom band and covering about the right half of the width. Inside it, three centered lines of near-black text: a first line in bold uppercase geometric sans; a second, much larger line in heavy condensed uppercase sans; a thin dark hairline rule; and a third line in regular-weight uppercase sans with wide letter spacing. Soft diffused light, clean, warm, feminine, premium look. No needles, syringes or medical imagery. No other text, badges, buttons, icons, stars or logos anywhere.
